in_hebrew.name: טבינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'tab', meaning to give or pour out. Tabina can be interpreted as a feminine form of the Hebrew word 'tab' meaning gift, grace, or favor.

in_greek.name: Ταβινα
in_greek.long_meaning: There is no direct Greek equivalent for the name Tabina. However, it is possible that the name could have been translated from Hebrew to Greek as Δώρη (Dorē), meaning gift or χάρις (Charis), meaning grace.

in_latin.name: Tabina
